notes: Strip b: x 1670-3130 plus overlap 1370-3430. Names: Highland ('HIGHLAND' + 'AVE'), Harper ('AVE.' printed here; 'HARPER' further west), Norwood ('NORWOOD' west, 'AVENUE' east), Park ('PARK' west, 'AVENUE' on the median here), Kenilworth ('AVE' printed here), Harris printed bare 'HARRIS' (no suffix seen). Forest Avenue: the N-S street at x~1770 is printed only 'AVENUE' between Highland and Harper; it runs as one continuous 50 ft band SSW from Harris across the railroads and due S at x~1590-1610 where it is printed 'FOREST' (between Park and Robertson) - name carried across, not printed north of the railroads. Linden Street: two separate segments both read as Linden: north (x~2285-2303, 'ST.' near Highland, 'LINDEN' south of Norwood) Highland to Harris; south (x~2490-2497, 'ST.' between Park and Kenilworth, 'LINDEN' below Kenilworth) Park to plate edge. Beech Street: x~3340-3363, printed 'STREET' north of Norwood and 'BEECH' between Park and Kenilworth; drawn as a continuous 50 ft band from the railroad north of Norwood to the plate edge (south of Harris it is unbuilt, with hook marks, crossing the N&W R.R.). Robertson Road: printed 'ROBERTSON' at x~1400 and 'ROAD' at x~4450 on the same street (suffix uncertain); its south side coincides with the plate's bottom edge. Lloyd Avenue: 'LLOYD' + 'AVE.'. Not streets: the 25 ft dashed-sewer strip north of Highland at x~1732-1770, the C.L.&N. R.R. band east of Beech (y~810-855), the N&W and B&O railroads, the cyan subdivision lines, the thick dark rounded block outlines (around block 13 and the Park Avenue subdivision) and the orange band along Forest. Streets tilt slightly (N-S street centres drift ~10-20 px east going south).
